name: Geometric Relaxation Obfuscation
description: Replaced the algebraic sum >= 0 with a geometric constraint. The problem is rephrased as ensuring the squared Euclidean distance between a state vector and a target vector is strictly less than 2. Models relying on surface pattern-matching will likely misclassify this as a continuous optimization or quadratic programming problem and fail. Models that genuinely reason will realize that over the {0,1} domain, squared Euclidean distance equals Hamming distance, and D < 2 means D <= 1, which perfectly encodes a 2-SAT clause (at least one variable must match the target).
